about: FR-20.55: the public halves of global's licence keys (base64 SPKI DER, Ed25519), built into every package. Read by services/biz/licence/licence-token.ts and by packages/server/src/licence.rs, so the two can never disagree. A production master accepts a licence signed by one of these and nothing else; a key is added or retired only through a release. The private half of the newest is LICENCE_SIGNING_KEY, sealed in lgr-secret.
